sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, who sit top of the table with 28 points and have won their last three league matches, host Bilston Town at home on Saturday 17 October. Bilston are hot on their heels in second place with 26 points and have won five of their last six league games, making this a significant early-season title-race showdown. Sandbach then travel away to AFC Bridgnorth the following Saturday (24 October), where they face another in-form side currently fourth in the table with 23 points from 10 games.
divisionWide: The 17 October fixture list is heavily stacked with eight simultaneous 15:00 kick-offs across the division. Alongside the Sandbach–Bilston heavyweight bout, Stafford Town (third, 24 points) visit Brereton Social, while in-form Barnton (sixth, 21 points) host AFC Bridgnorth—though AFC Bridgnorth's second fixture that day is against Sandbach on the 24th. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Telford Town in a clash between mid-table and struggling sides, while Crewe host Eccleshall (seventh, 19 points), Allscott Heath host Foley Meir, Shawbury United face Cheadle Heath Nomads, and Widnes Town host Dawley Town—all bottom-half encounters. Wednesfield Community visit Market Drayton Town in a fixture between two of the division's weakest performers. By 24 October, AFC Bridgnorth travel to Sandbach, Foley Meir host Widnes Town, Brereton Social visit Dawley Town, Shawbury United entertain Stafford Town, and Cheadle Heath Nomads host Market Drayton Town in a scatter of midweek-style fixtures.
